name: Quality Assurance
description: Ability to perform and participate in quality assurance processes for security engagements. Covers peer and technical review of work, methodology compliance checks, report QA, proficiency testing and interlaboratory comparisons (ISO/IEC 17025:2017 clause 7.7), control of nonconforming work (7.10), corrective action (8.7), and continuous improvement of lab processes.

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose of QA in a security lab
evidence: Can explain why peer review and QA processes exist
Familiar with the lab's QA workflow

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Participates in QA processes; submits work for review following procedures
evidence: Consistently submits work for peer review before delivery

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Performs QA reviews on others' work; identifies deviations from methodology
evidence: Conducts peer review of engagement reports and deliverables
Catches substantive issues during review (not just formatting)

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Leads QA processes; identifies systemic quality issues; drives improvements
evidence: Identifies patterns in QA findings and drives process improvements
Leads QA for complex or high-profile engagements
Mentors junior staff on quality standards

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Designs QA framework; manages lab quality system; handles audit preparation
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's quality management system
Prepares for and supports accreditation or external audits
Trains teams on quality assurance methodology

assessment_methods.description: Review QA feedback provided on 3 recent peer reviews for quality and thoroughness
Observe a QA review session and assess the individual's review process
